start: Settings, Your data, Backup and restore, signed out, workouts on the phone and on MettleUp

user_sees: 'Sign in with Google to keep your workouts safe. ...'
'Only you can see what is saved. Your gym cannot. Progress photos stay on this phone.'
must_not: The card missing when sign-in is set up

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google' and choose an account
user_sees: '12 workouts brought back to this phone.' (or 'Everything was already on this phone.')
must_not: A workout on the phone twice
This phone's state sent up before the server copy came in

start: Welcome screen on a new phone, the member used MettleUp before

steps.action: Tick to confirm 18 or older and accept the terms, tap 'Continue with Google'
user_sees: The app opens as theirs, with their profile and workouts back
must_not: The phone number or body weight taken from the copy
The 3 questions asked when a kept profile exists

steps.action: Same, but nothing was ever saved on MettleUp
user_sees: 'You are signed in. Nothing is saved yet, so answer the 3 questions to start.'
must_not: An empty app opened with no profile

start: Settings account card, signed in, a workout open

user_sees: 'Finish your workout first, then try again.'
must_not: The open workout replaced or merged mid-set

steps.action: Finish the workout, tap 'Bring my workouts' again
user_sees: 'N workouts brought back to this phone.'

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google' with no internet
user_sees: 'Could not sign in with Google. Check your internet and try again.'
must_not: The member shown as signed in

steps.action: Same on a phone with the demo data
user_sees: 'This phone has the demo data. Remove it first (Settings → "Erase or start over"), then try again.'

steps.action: Same with a Google account that is not the one this phone was saved with
user_sees: 'This phone has another person’s workouts. To use a different Google account, first erase this phone in Settings → "Erase or start over".'
must_not: One person's workouts merged into another's account

steps.action: Tap 'Sign out', then 'Sign out' in 'Sign out of MettleUp?'
user_sees: 'Your workouts stay on this phone. New workouts are not saved on MettleUp until you sign in again.'
The card back to 'Continue with Google'
must_not: New workouts still sent after sign-out

steps.action: Sign in again, tap 'Delete my account', then 'Delete account' in 'Delete your MettleUp account?'
user_sees: 'Your account and everything saved on MettleUp are deleted. Your workouts are still on this phone.'
must_not: Anything left on the server copy

start: Signed in, member of a gym

steps.action: Train for a week, then the gym opens its admin app
user_sees: The gym sees none of the saved copy
must_not: The gym's admin app showing the member's saved workouts
